— About Us

Rooted in the Soil of India

India's farmers work tirelessly to grow some of the world's finest rice. Yet for decades, the fruit of their labor passed through so many hands that quality dropped and farmers earned far less than they deserved.

Pure Gramin was founded in 2025 to fix this broken chain. We work directly with farming communities, source the finest paddy, and process it into premium poha that carries the true taste of the countryside.

"Every packet you buy puts more money in a farmer's pocket and more goodness on your plate."

— Our Story

We Said Enough.

India's farmers work tirelessly to grow some of the world's finest rice. Yet for decades, the fruit of their labor passed through so many hands that by the time it reached your kitchen, quality had dropped and farmers had earned far less than they deserved.

Pure Gramin was founded in 2025 to fix this broken chain. We work directly with farming communities, source the finest paddy, and process it into premium poha that carries the true taste of the countryside.

"When you choose Pure Gramin, you're not just buying poha — you're investing in a more equitable food system."

🤝 We Go Direct

We partner directly with farmers, cutting out every unnecessary middleman. Farmers earn better, and you get fresher, higher-quality poha at a fair price.

🌾 We Source the Best

We carefully select the finest paddy from trusted growers who follow responsible farming practices — no shortcuts, no compromises.

🌿 We Keep It Pure

Minimally processed, free from additives, packed fresh. What you open is exactly what the farmer grew.

🏡 We Support Rural India

Every purchase supports farming families and rural livelihoods across India.
